stories.title: North Wales Police warns of criminals using AI to promote fake investment schemes
stories.summary: Criminals are using deepfake videos and images to make fake investment offers look genuine, with over-60s most affected, the force says.

stories.title: Guaranteed jobs scheme for young people extended to Flintshire as claimant numbers rise
stories.summary: The number of 18 to 24 year olds in Flintshire claiming unemployment-related benefits has risen by a quarter in a year, as a UK government scheme guaranteeing young people a paid job is extended to the county for the first time. Office for National Statistics figures show 645 people aged 18 to 24 in Flintshire

stories.title: Welsh Labour leader Ken Skates says sorry to Wales for party’s worst ever election result
stories.summary: Welsh Labour leader Ken Skates has apologised to the people of Wales for what he called the worst result in Welsh Labour’s history. stories.title: Council asked to apologise over £516,000 for schools
stories.summary: The motion says the money was restored only after an amendment was carried against the wishes of the deputy leader who proposed the original motion.

stories.title: Police target drink and drug drivers overnight in South Flintshire after five arrests in 24 hours
stories.summary: Police in South Flintshire are out through the night targeting drink and drug drivers after five arrests in 24 hours. North Wales Police’s South Flintshire team said two of the arrests were for driving offences, one involving drink and one involving drugs.
